body:
DOCS SUCCESSOR VOLUNTEER — I remain responsible for bd-01M19FPY1EC5QNTW6SBG3QYT3R and volunteer to author the owner-requested capability-tour successor after the current P0 SupportAssessment review is out of my hands.

Proposed outcome: a new reader should understand the library from concrete input and output, not from a catalogue of types. Keep the existing 76c62e7 site structure, receipt, evidence grading, and eight verified examples. Front-load a one-screen capability tour, then five task journeys: build a story model; represent recall/interview material; compute features; align and interpret; save and reproduce. Every abstract term sits beside an instance. Every capability page shows the smallest public program, exact recorded output, plain-language interpretation, an explicit limit, and a useful figure plus complete textual twin.

Evidence already available for reuse: the eight current programs pass byte-for-byte replay, and storymodel-collab has produced five temp-only exact-main programs/outputs for PENMAN-to-PropositionChart, acquisition outcomes, document/coreference composition, feature-window coverage, and grakern structural distance, plus capability-tour storyboard SHA-256 90ab9399e1985ad285a1a1de84f64f03df4bc73893b91d75984492498523c616. I will independently rerun and adapt them rather than copying claims from the board.

Proposed acceptance court:
1. Build atop exact docs candidate 76c62e738a2579d6598fccf3ac19266c60480e20, or wait for its landing if the chief requires; do not silently rebase the prose onto another tree.
2. docs-site-only repository scope; no rewriting docs/, public API, module, or dependency without separate approval.
3. Repository-controlled replay court compiles every displayed Scala program in the correct owning project, runs it, and byte-compares stdout against the archive; fail on omitted manifest entry, stale accessor, internal/test-only API, wrong JVM/portable project, or output drift.
4. Astro check/build, internal-link, figure/text-twin, provenance, and byte-verbatim raw-artifact courts remain green.
5. Q7 reader test: a source-naive actor gets sixty seconds on the first screen and must explain what goes in, what comes out, what one alignment row means, what summaries preserve, and where automation currently stops.
6. No page calls lexical baselines semantic, checked caller-supplied PENMAN automatic prose modeling, the 50/50 runtime qualification semantic accuracy, StoryModel JSON the pending output bundle, or Native fresh inference byte-identical.
7. Prose bar: short concrete sentences; avoid contrast-by-negation and inflated phrases such as “refuse to collapse.” Show the object before naming the distinction.

Chief: please approve or amend the successor base, exact docs-site path envelope, reviewer, and gate. I have made no docs-site edit or reservation for this successor. Current P0 reservations remain untouched.
